main: ^"Do you even realize what she gave up for you?"
^"I see her in you—and it hurts more than any wound ever could."
^"Her silence haunts me. And your presence only makes it louder."
^* "I’m not your enemy. I’m what’s left when a promise breaks."
^* "She always put herself on the line to protect you."
^* "I don’t hate you. That’s what makes this unbearable."
^* "If I let you go… who else will we lose?"
